up: Find compounds selective for CHEMBL203 over CHEMBL1824 based on IC50 values. A compound qualifies if it has an IC50 value < 50 nM against CHEMBL203 and an IC50 value > 200 nM against CHEMBL1824. Only consider activity rows where standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', and standard_relation = '='. Return exactly two columns: compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Ensure the query correctly intersects the sets of compounds meeting each target's criteria to avoid duplicates.
sql:
WITH target203_hits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND a.standard_value < 50
),
target1824_hits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1824'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND a.standard_value > 200
)
SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM target203_hits t203
JOIN target1824_hits t1824 ON t203.molregno = t1824.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON t203.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON t203.molregno = cs.molregno
